candidates.basis: The existing production archive was decoded by the official djxl exact-JPEG path to the original 2,725,495-byte JPEG and SHA-256 a1cb8de1d3b91edbb7e05233c7930200c46e04554c3651153e267e5abd262138. Commercial use remains conditional on preserving libjxl and bundled third-party notices and on the existing product's dependency audit.

The unmodified official v0.5.8 utility restored the same original JPEG byte-for-byte and is 55,614 bytes (2.510399%) smaller than this photo's production JXL. The core is Apache-2.0 and the locked aarch64-apple-ios normal/build dependency tree contains permissive Apache-2.0, MIT, BSD-2-Clause, Zlib, 0BSD, Unlicense, and Unicode-3.0 choices. Promotion remains conditional on notices, an iOS ARM64 build, and independent phone-bundle validation; the locked ScanCode broker was attempted but could not start because the local Docker service was unavailable.

Official PyArrow read/write restored all 1,048,576 descriptor bytes exactly, but the archive is 61,880 bytes larger than the same input's 779,453-byte ZPAQ baseline. Apache Arrow is Apache-2.0; any product use is conditional on a binary-level transitive notice audit.

candidates.parameters: ORC 0.12 binary column; Zstd; one stripe
candidates.basis: Official PyArrow ORC restored the descriptor block exactly, but is 63,399 bytes larger than ZPAQ. Apache ORC/Arrow licensing is commercially permissive under Apache-2.0, conditional on preserving applicable notices and auditing the shipped binary dependency closure.

candidates.parameters: dense uint8 [8192,128]; Zstd level 22; all four persisted files counted
candidates.basis: The complete official TileDB array restored exactly, but is 62,342 bytes larger than ZPAQ. TileDB-Py is MIT; product use is conditional on notices and a full audit of the TileDB core binary and transitive dependencies.

candidates.parameters: mkdwarfs level 9; LZMA level 9; Nilsimsa ordering
candidates.basis: Official DwarFS 0.15.6 restored the JPEG, descriptor block, and real PLY exactly, but only reduced their raw sum by 8.16% and loses to per-type archives. The upstream LICENSE explicitly places the writer and rewrite libraries under GPL-3.0 while reader-side libraries are MIT; embedding the required writer in the closed commercial iPhone app conflicts with the intended distribution model.

candidates.parameters: vertex codec version 1; level 3; xyz and padded rgb streams; then unchanged ZPAQ method 5
candidates.basis: The official lossless vertex codec restored every float bit and RGB byte, and the framed PLY reconstructed byte-for-byte. Even after the same ZPAQ backend it is 101,581 bytes larger than compressing the PLY directly. The core is MIT with a notice obligation; patent and final shipped-dependency review remain separate.
